status: PLACEHOLDER: to be written by Rhythm Thakur and Manish Raje in English, Hindi and Marathi and reviewed by the owner (M8 §3.2, owner 2026-10-09). Only titles and summaries are translated here; questions fall back to English.

en.title: Using the GharBasket app
en.summary: Switch to your partner role, read your tasks and ask the hub for help.

questions.text: Where do you switch between customer and partner mode?
Who do you call when something goes wrong with a task?
Can you share a customer's phone number with others?
When is your week's earnings view updated?
What should you do if the app shows an error?
options: Try again, then tell the hub

hi.title: GharBasket ऐप का उपयोग
hi.summary: पार्टनर भूमिका चुनें, अपने काम देखें और हब से मदद लें।

mr.title: GharBasket ॲप वापरणे
mr.summary: पार्टनर भूमिका निवडा, तुमची कामे पाहा आणि हबकडून मदत घ्या.

en.title: Kitchen hygiene
en.summary: Clean hands, covered hair, clean surfaces and fresh food, every day.

questions.text: When must you wash your hands?
options: Only at the end of the day
Before touching food and after every break

questions.text: What covers your hair while you cook or pack?
Can you use yesterday's cooked food in today's tiffin?
How should raw and cooked food be kept?
You have a fever. What do you do?
options: Tell the hub and do not handle food

hi.title: रसोई की स्वच्छता
hi.summary: साफ़ हाथ, ढके बाल, साफ़ सतह और ताज़ा खाना, हर दिन।

mr.title: स्वयंपाकघरातील स्वच्छता
mr.summary: स्वच्छ हात, झाकलेले केस, स्वच्छ जागा आणि ताजे अन्न, दररोज.

en.title: Running your tiffin kitchen
en.summary: Set your capacity, answer offers by 22:30, cook, mark ready and hand over.

questions.text: By when must you accept or decline tomorrow's offer?
What do you set so you only get as many portions as you can cook?
When can you mark a tiffin ready?
options: When the hygiene checklist is complete

questions.text: What is written on each box?
How does the rider collect your tiffins?

hi.title: टिफ़िन रसोई चलाना
hi.summary: क्षमता तय करें, 22:30 तक ऑफ़र का जवाब दें, खाना बनाएँ, तैयार करें और सौंपें।

mr.title: टिफिन स्वयंपाकघर चालवणे
mr.summary: क्षमता ठरवा, 22:30 पर्यंत ऑफरला उत्तर द्या, स्वयंपाक करा, तयार करा आणि सोपवा.

en.title: The society handover
en.summary: Receive the bags at the gate, check them, and give each family its bag.

questions.text: What do you check when the rider hands over the bags?
A bag is missing. What do you do?
When do you mark a bag delivered?
Where do you keep bags waiting for pickup?
Can you share a family's order with neighbours?

hi.title: सोसाइटी में हैंडओवर
hi.summary: गेट पर बैग लें, जाँचें और हर परिवार को उसका बैग दें।

mr.title: सोसायटीतील हस्तांतरण
mr.summary: गेटवर पिशव्या घ्या, तपासा आणि प्रत्येक कुटुंबाला त्याची पिशवी द्या.

en.title: Riding safely
en.summary: Helmet on, follow the route, no phone while riding, scan at every stop.

questions.text: What do you wear on every ride?
Can you use your phone while riding?
What do you do at each society gate?
options: Hand over to the captain in the app

questions.text: Your vehicle breaks down. What do you do?
options: Ask a customer for a lift

questions.text: Which route do you follow?

hi.title: सुरक्षित सवारी
hi.summary: हेलमेट पहनें, रूट पर चलें, चलाते समय फ़ोन नहीं, हर स्टॉप पर स्कैन करें।

mr.title: सुरक्षित प्रवास
mr.summary: हेल्मेट घाला, मार्गाने जा, चालवताना फोन नको, प्रत्येक थांब्यावर स्कॅन करा.

en.title: Packing a family's bag
en.summary: Pick by the list, weigh loose items, seal the bag and label it.

questions.text: How do you know what goes into a bag?
options: The pick list in the app

questions.text: An item is out of stock. What do you do?
options: Mark it short in the app

questions.text: Where do heavy items go?
What is on the label?
When is a bag packed?
options: When every line is picked and it is sealed

hi.title: परिवार का बैग पैक करना
hi.summary: सूची से चुनें, खुला सामान तौलें, बैग सील करें और लेबल लगाएँ।

mr.title: कुटुंबाची पिशवी भरणे
mr.summary: यादीनुसार निवडा, सुटे सामान वजन करा, पिशवी बंद करा आणि लेबल लावा.
